registry.primaryAudience: People writing down temporary support, expectations, check-ins, and updates.
registry.problemSolved: Helps someone record what was covered, what should happen next, and how timing changes should be handled.
registry.useWhen: Use when support has already been agreed and the people involved want the record to stay clear.
registry.nextStep: Use the payment plan calculator.

bestNextSteps.heading: After the support record is written
bestNextSteps.intro: A written record may be enough for simple support. If repayment, partial payments, or updates continue, choose the next practical step.

steps.label: Track
steps.title: Track temporary support over time
steps.description: Use this when the record is likely to keep changing with repayments, reminders, or new updates.

steps.label: Partial
